_comment: ADR-0367 pilot, issue #15292; spec openbank-libs/governance/returns/ceu-daily.yaml. CEÚ daily change overview (ČNB report CEUSIFE10, methodology CEU20211201) under zákon č. 300/2016 Sb. and vyhláška č. 30/2017 Sb. as amended by 163/2021 Sb. One return per WORKING_DAY window: the window ends the day before a CERTIS working day and is due on that working day (ČNB: by 12:00; the date-level deadline here is the day, the 12:00 cut-off is the scheduler's job). THE CEUSIFE10 DATA-FILE XSD IS PUBLISHED ONLY INSIDE SDAT AND WAS NOT OBTAINED: wireFormatVerified is false and no wire renderer is bound. Line fields and datapoint ids are PLATFORM identifiers, not CEUSIFE10 elements; person data (name, birth number, address) is not carried here and is read from party-service at render time.
